name: SAC
summary: SAC augments the reward with a policy-entropy term and learns off-policy from a replay buffer, giving both strong exploration and much better sample efficiency than on-policy methods. That combination made it the standard choice whenever RL has to touch physical hardware, and it remains the backbone of real-world manipulation RL systems such as SERL.
innovation: Maximum-entropy objective producing robust, exploratory policies without hand-tuned noise schedules.
Off-policy replay making real-robot training feasible in hours rather than weeks.
matters: The algorithmic core of nearly every real-world robot RL result of the last several years.
limits: Still needs a reward function and a reset mechanism, both hard to arrange in the real world.
lineage: Root of the off-policy branch used for real-robot manipulation RL.
